shortDescription: Manage software images on a BIG-IP

options.name: force
options.description: When C(true), uploads the file every time and replaces the file on the device. When C(false), the file is only uploaded if it does not already exist. Generally should be C(true) only in cases where you have reason to believe the image was corrupted during upload.

options.name: image
options.description: The image to put on the remote device. This may be an absolute or relative location on the Ansible controller. Image names, whether they are base ISOs or hotfix ISOs, B(must) be unique.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the image is uploaded. When C(absent), ensures the image is removed.
